unidentified.title: Mysterious Note
pickupText: It's the complete Doodlejiggy™ developer manual.

identified.title: Doodlejiggy™ Developer Manual
description: It's a manual for something called Doodlejiggy™ — a Dynamic Object-Oriented Dialogue & Logic Engine powered by JIGGY™ technology.
JIGGY apparently stands for 'Just Interactive Geometry, Graphics & Yokes.' I still don't know what the Yoke is.
The manual consists of a single aggressively confident page.
According to the cover, this is the 'definitive reference edition.'
The manual proudly claims 'No additional documentation required.'
It's surprisingly short for something involving this many acronyms.
Most of the page is occupied by the word 'YOKES' in bold.
I still don't know what the Yoke is, but it seems extremely important.

odd_plush.title: Odd Plush Toy
description: A purple plush toy.
It has a surprisingly unpleasant expression.
I get the feeling it has plans for the future.

dog_bed.title: Dog Bed
description: This seems to belong to the highest-ranking lifeform in the house.
Whoever sleeps here has things pretty well figured out.
The bed is currently unoccupied.
I should probably leave it exactly as it is.
A fluffy pig toy for dogs. Most of its original dignity has been chewed away.
Somewhere along the way, it also became a modern 'Smart Toy' for pets.
There's definitely more technology inside this dog toy than feels necessary.

peanut_butter.title: Peanut-Smeared Piggy
description: Piggy is now lightly smeared with peanut butter.
It smells considerably more interesting than it did a moment ago.
Peanut butter aside, it's still a modern 'Smart Toy' for pets.
The electronics inside have acquired some unexpected competition.

unidentified.title: Sticky Mess
unidentified.description: A coffee cup, a butter knife, and the remains of a peanut butter-related incident occupy the table.

identified.title: Abandoned Snack
description: Someone appears to have left in a hurry, or simply lowered their standards.
The peanut butter still smells surprisingly fresh.

fruit_bowl.title: Fruit Bowl
description: A bowl of fruit.
It looked healthier from across the room.
Up close, it's plastic and vaguely disappointing.

artwork.title: Ghost Pirate Artwork
description: Something about this artwork feels legendary.
Those two pirates don't seem particularly fond of each other.
I don't know why, but I could look at this all day.

computer.title: Computer
description: A desktop computer surrounded by suspiciously well-organized cables.
Whoever set this up almost certainly owns a label maker.
Currently powered off. Probably for the best.

unidentified.title: Suspicious Electronic Device
unidentified.description: The casing is covered in microscopic text. I can just make out 'SmartPlay™ Companion Intelligence Module'.
pickupText: Some kind of electronic module appears to have fallen out of Piggy.

identified.title: SmartPlay™ Companion Intelligence Module
description: A tiny processing module recovered from inside Piggy.
It contains more computing power than seems strictly necessary for making squeaking noises.
The manufacturer appears to have taken a highly experimental approach to safeguards.
Whatever this thing normally does, it doesn't appear to believe in idle time.

whiteboard.title: Whiteboard
description: Every inch is covered in equations, diagrams, and frantic notes.
Some sections have been written over again and again.
Words like 'scene', 'engine', 'portal', and 'script' appear over and over.
Half of it reads like unfinished code. The other half reads like a survival journal.

photographs.title: Photographs
description: One of these photographs looks just like me.
The rest also seem oddly familiar.
Someone has been keeping track of this place.

clues.title: Clues
description: Pages of notes connected with lengths of red thread.
Some of the oldest notes have been revised over and over.
Whatever they were trying to find, they never finished.

markers.title: Whiteboard Markers
description: A mug full of worn whiteboard markers.
None of them look like they've worked in a very long time.
They've clearly outlived their intended purpose.

dark_corner.title: Dark Corner
description: Just a dark corner.
Still just a dark corner.
I'm beginning to suspect this is exactly what it looks like.
I don't think there's anything more to it.
